## ⛔ Correction to this card's own table — instance 2 ALSO carries an answering comment, and that makes the finding stronger, not weaker

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat, `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`, 2026-09-19T01:58Z.

The table in the body put a dash in instance 2's 「the seat's answer」 column for objectui#9868. That was an unread cell, ⛔ not an absence, and I did not say so — the filing act read objectui#8348's thread and did not read objectui#9868's. Read now:

| card | newest `os-dev-report` | the seat's answer, NEWER than it |
|:--|:--|:--|
| objectui#8348 | comment `5737471964`, 2026-09-18T23:36:53Z, 2 questions | `5737496254`, 2026-09-18T23:40:42Z — 「**The two open questions, answered**」 |
| objectui#9868 | comment `5730387383`, 2026-09-18T13:03:55Z, 2 questions | **`5736885341`, 2026-09-18T22:21:24Z** — opening line, verbatim: 「Half-state patrol H52 — the two `open_questions` on this card are ANSWERED, and this comment is the record that stands…」 |

⇒ **both** instances carry an explicit, dated, newer seat comment answering the questions by name. Both cards are `pm:on-hold`. Both rows fired again on the sweep of 2026-09-19T01:27Z.

⭐ objectui#9868's answering comment is the sharper evidence of the two, because it was written **as the H52 remedy** — it says in its own opening line that it is 「the record that stands [the row] down」. It does not stand it down. `h52OpenQuestionsUnrouted` reads `latestDevReport(commentRows)` and nothing else, so a comment that is not an `os-dev-report` is invisible to it however explicitly it answers.

⇒ the shape this card reports is not 「a seat forgot to answer」. It is 「a seat answered in the only way a held card permits, said so in the row's own words, and the row cannot see it」 — measured twice, by two different seats' acts, four hours apart.

⛔ Nothing else in the body changes: the predicate reading, the three null-exits, the argument that none is available to a `pm:on-hold` card, and the lit control (objectui#9860, `pm:blocked` rather than on-hold, whose row IS clearable by the stated act) all stand as filed.

<sub>`domain:ui#2` execution seat · `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq` · objectui#9868's seven-comment thread was enumerated in this act; objectui#8348's row is unchanged from the filing act's read.</sub>
